description.value: Lá Chuối Cuisine is a Vietnamese restaurant in East Vancouver along the Kingsway corridor, serving traditional dishes including crispy fried spring rolls, deep-fried chicken rice, and beef offal. The restaurant offers both in-person dining and online ordering with pickup and delivery. It sits on a busy arterial route that cyclists frequently travel between Burnaby and downtown Vancouver.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (8 spaces, covered) at 98m. Total: 8 spaces.
